summary: Tested enriched /api/orchestration/calendar (per-service entries from proposal order_items) plus new EventCalendarTab with Month and Week timeline views. Backend: 4/4 pytest tests pass — calendar returns calendar_dates on each event, multi-day expansion works (Reorder Test Event 08-01/03/05), and 'Servicio Multi-Horario Test' returns 3 services (Desayuno 08:00→10:00, Almuerzo 12:00→14:00, Coffee Break PM 16:00→17:00) all on 2026-05-20. Frontend: Month view shows 3 time-prefixed chips on 2026-05-20; Week view renders 3 positioned colored blocks with correct times on WED 20; clicking a block opens side panel with 'Servicios' subsection listing all 3 services; Month view for multi-day Reorder Test Event correctly shows section chips on 08-01, 08-03, 08-05.
critical_code_review_comments: EventCalendarTab.js — `explodeEventsIntoEntries` falls back to cds[0] for services without a date, which is correct for single-day events but for multi-day events without per-service date it concentrates all services on day 1 only (current behavior is intentional per spec but worth a comment).
Week view hard-codes 07:00–22:00 at 56px per row; services starting before 07:00 or after 22:00 would be clipped silently. Consider clamping with overflow indicator.

calendar-event-pill data-testid was not detected for multi-day Reorder Test Event in August (only service-chip testids fire). Confirm that any event without services still falls through to a pill so the UI is never blank — verified via test_calendar_endpoint_returns_events_structure that all events have calendar_dates.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing seeded event_test_timed_services (2026-05-20, sections at 08:00/12:00/16:00) and event_42ccd0133529 Reorder Test Event (event_dates 2026-08-01/03/05).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend: GET /api/orchestration/calendar?start_date=&end_date= returns {events:[{event_id,name,calendar_dates:[...],services:[{date,time,end_time,title,item_count}], ...}], conflicts:{date:[event_ids]}}. Frontend route /event-orchestration/calendar uses EventCalendarTab with isGlobal=true. Toggle data-testid='calendar-view-month'/'calendar-view-week'. Service chips data-testid='calendar-service-{event_id}-{i}' (month) and 'calendar-week-block-{event_id}-{i}' (week). Side panel data-testid='calendar-event-details' with subsection 'calendar-event-services'. Login uses data-testid='login-submit-btn' (not role=button name=Continue, which is ambiguous with google-login-btn).
